the vitepress server throws these warnings:
```
Failed to index de/guide/canvas-rce.md for search: incomplete explicit mapping pair; a key node is missed; or followed by a non-tabulated empty line at line 2, column 14:
    title: Canvas: Remote-Code-Ausführung (RCE)

```
I’ll trace those localized VitePress pages and the source/generator that produces their frontmatter, then patch the smallest place that prevents unquoted colons from breaking YAML.
The repo’s graph rules apply here, so I’m using that as the first locator for the code path, with the locale gotcha note in mind since this smells like generated localized Markdown frontmatter.

data.content: The graph output is larger than the chat pane, so I’m opening the saved result and then I’ll jump straight to the top hit rather than sweeping the repo.

The warning points at raw Markdown frontmatter, and the graph’s closest real hit is the Canvas RCE docs/theme surface. I’m checking the affected files plus the guide-generation scripts now; the likely fix is to quote serialized YAML values, not hand-edit three translated pages.
That confirms the bad YAML: translated titles containing `: ` are written unquoted. I’m narrowing one hop to the locale writer/segmenter so the regeneration path stays fixed too.

The docs guide translator preserves whole frontmatter blocks, so the broken value probably entered through the i18n engine’s frontmatter renderer rather than the Markdown segmenter. I’ve found that code has a YAML escape helper already, so the next read is to see why this page bypassed it.

The guide translator is whole-file based, so model output can mutate frontmatter directly and sidestep the i18n engine’s frontmatter escaping. I’m going to add a small guard at the guide-write boundary and update the current generated pages so today’s dev server stops warning.

I’m making this a writer-side fix: sanitize only the leading YAML frontmatter that comes back from the guide translator, leaving Markdown body text untouched. Then I’ll validate it with a focused test for colon-bearing titles.

I’ve got the local hypothesis pinned down: any guide translation whose frontmatter title becomes a plain YAML scalar with `: ` will break VitePress search indexing. The cheap check is a unit test around the guide-frontmatter sanitizer plus a YAML parse check on the affected pages.

data.content:
Implemented the VitePress warning fix.

I added [docs/scripts/guide-frontmatter.ts](docs/scripts/guide-frontmatter.ts) and wired it into [docs/scripts/translate-guide-po.ts](docs/scripts/translate-guide-po.ts) so whole-guide translations now quote frontmatter scalar values that contain YAML mapping colons like `Canvas: ...`. I also updated the currently broken localized Canvas RCE pages and their cached PO entries:

[docs/de/guide/canvas-rce.md](docs/de/guide/canvas-rce.md), [docs/fi/guide/canvas-rce.md](docs/fi/guide/canvas-rce.md), [docs/is/guide/canvas-rce.md](docs/is/guide/canvas-rce.md)  
[l10n/de/docs.guides.po](l10n/de/docs.guides.po), [l10n/fi/docs.guides.po](l10n/fi/docs.guides.po), [l10n/is/docs.guides.po](l10n/is/docs.guides.po)

Added focused coverage in [docs/scripts/guide-frontmatter.test.ts](docs/scripts/guide-frontmatter.test.ts) and a changeset at [.changeset/quote-guide-frontmatter.md](.changeset/quote-guide-frontmatter.md).

Validation:
- `runTests` for [docs/scripts/guide-frontmatter.test.ts](docs/scripts/guide-frontmatter.test.ts): passed.
- Ruby YAML parse of the three affected pages: passed.
- Scan for remaining unquoted localized guide `title:` values containing `: `: none found.
- TypeScript diagnostics on touched script files: clean.
- `vp test --coverage`: failed on existing unrelated broad-suite issues:
  - [renderers/tinymce/tests/skins.test.ts](renderers/tinymce/tests/skins.test.ts): expected single-quoted Less imports, found double quotes.
  - [tools/i18n-engine/tests/lint.test.ts](tools/i18n-engine/tests/lint.test.ts): missing `layouts.strings.po` catalogs across locales.
  - [tools/i18n-engine/tests/pipeline-guides.test.ts](tools/i18n-engine/tests/pipeline-guides.test.ts): existing Spanish guide PO/page byte mismatch from trailing whitespace.

I left the pre-existing dirty scaffold template files untouched.
